evidence: Clear module-based organization with 14 packages (e.g., siuba.dply, siuba.sql, siuba.siu, siuba.experimental) reflecting cohesive functional domains
High cohesion within modules: each package has focused responsibilities (e.g., verbs.py for core dplyr-style operations, translate.py for SQL translation)
Low inter-package coupling: avg_fan_out of ~3.7 indicates limited dependencies between modules
Shared core components (siu package) used across modules (dply, sql, ops) without tight coupling
Backend abstraction via AbstractBackend and dialect-specific implementations (dialects/ directory) without service boundaries
No evidence of service communication patterns (no RPC frameworks, message queues, or network endpoints)
Single deployment unit (setup.py, single repository tree)
Symbolic expression engine (siu) and verb implementations (verbs.py) are tightly integrated but cleanly separated by concern
risks: Risk of increasing coupling between modules as experimental features grow (e.g., experimental/pivot, experimental/pd_groups)
Potential for siu module to become a monolithic dependency if symbolic expression logic isn't carefully maintained
Backend-specific logic is embedded in dialect modules rather than cleanly abstracted via ports/adapters
